newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Stock Exchange may suspend basket warrants trade. [CORRECTED 03:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: HK Stock Exchange may suspend basket warrants trade. [CORRECTED 03:00 GMT]

text.p: The Hong Kong Stock Exchange will suspend trading in a covered warrant issued on a basket of shares, if and when one of the underlying shares is suspended from trading (Corrects to clarify that warrant trade suspension is conditional on suspension of underlying share.)
The suspension had to be made because the underlying securities represented more than 30 percent of the total value of all securities comprised in the basket, it said in a statement.

Unlike normal warrants which covers one stock, basket warrants comprise more than one stock. Basket warrants is a type of warrant issued by merchant banks to cover a few stocks which have either the same nature of business or concepts, such as H-shares concept or red-chips concept.
